reviews.title: Great price great performance.
reviews.comment:
Typically NZXT is known for bad price to performance as the brand is typically esthetics over function. Thats not to say that their products dont work, but typically its more expensive for worse performance but takes the cake for a good looking build. That however does not apply to this power supply.

This unit has excellent efficiency for a great price and I have no regrets about my purchase. It also comes with a bag to store all the modular cables that you might not use.
